title: MonaPaper
tagline: Bring Monaverse spaces to your Android and macOS home screens with daily featured spaces
description:
MonaPaper lets you immerse into different Monaverse right from your home screens. Get access to beautiful and daily updated mona spaces on your Android phones and macOS laptops.

Android app
 - Explore trending spaces in a beautifully designed Android app
- Preview spaces quickly
- Set spaces as live wallpapers and take immersion to your home and lock screens
- Interactive spaces that reacts to how you move your phone around in home screen
- Updated daily with featured space or select your own space

macOS app
- macOS wallpaper updated daily with the featured mona space
- view Space details in a beautifully designed macOS app and a menu bar app to quickly shuffle to next space
- Save current wallpaper
- Blur and Dim wallpapers for event more enhanced desktop
how_its_made: We scraped Mona spaces data for now to seed starting spaces data (we would prefer if there was an API available). Android app is made in native kotlin with LiveWallpaperService to put Mona spaces in user's home and lock screens.  macOS app is simple menu bar app that updates the wallpaper daily with feature space and a window to view space details
